wargear.name: Sigillite's black seal
wargear.summary: A wax-and-steel writ carrying Malcador's personal authority, which opens any door and closes most arguments.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Sigillite's black seal adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic.

wargear.name: Shroud-cloak of the Talons
wargear.summary: A cameleoline mantle woven in the Sigillite's own workshops.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Shroud-cloak of the Talons adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic and has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Seeker's death-mask
wargear.summary: A lacquered faceplate worn by those who hunt oath-breakers, said to still every doubt behind it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Seeker's death-mask has the Unblinking Mask Special Rule.

wargear.name: Reliquary of Terran ash
wargear.summary: A sealed flask of ash gathered from the Palace grounds and kept against the heart.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Reliquary of Terran ash has the Ashes of the Oath Special Rule.

wargear.name: Warding strand
wargear.summary: A braid of silvered wire and prayer-tags knotted across the shoulder guards.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Warding strand has the Strand of Warding Special Rule.

wargear.name: Quarry lens
wargear.summary: An optic tuned to a single writ-signature, scanning for the one face it has been told to find.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Quarry lens has the Marked Quarry Special Rule.

wargear.name: Spite plating
wargear.summary: Plates scavenged from fallen cell-engines, riveted over fresh wounds.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Spite plating adds 1 to its Toughness Characteristic, subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic and has the Plated in Spite Special Rule.

wargear.name: Chaff pods
wargear.summary: Drop-pods of sheared foil and radiating filament, fired to blind pursuing guns.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Chaff pods has the Chaff Veil Special Rule.

modifiers.text: Shroud-cloak of the Talons: +1 I, Shrouded (6+).
Reliquary of Terran ash: Feel No Pain (6+), Ashes of the Oath.
Spite plating: Plated in Spite, +1 T, -1 M.

rules.name: Oath-Bonded
rules.summary: Those who followed Garro followed him because they chose to.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of Nathaniel Garro or Tylos Rubio, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Leadership and Cool Characteristics when the Unit takes a Morale Check or a Cool Check.

rules.name: Sealed Orders
rules.summary: The order was sealed before launch, and nobody aboard knows what it says.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Outflank Special Rule. In a Battle Turn in which a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule arrives from Reserves, that Unit may Rush and still make a Shooting Attack with one of its Weapons, using its full Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Unwitnessed
rules.summary: No witness, no record, no trial.
rules.text: During the first Battle Turn, enemy Units cannot target a Model with this Special Rule with a Shooting Attack unless that Model is within 12" of them.

rules.name: Unblinking Mask
rules.summary: The mask stills every doubt behind it, and sows them in front.
rules.text: Enemy Models in a Challenge with a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from the result of their Focus Roll.

rules.name: Ashes of the Oath
rules.summary: The ashes of Terra rest against the heart, and nothing the warp offers can shake them.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule and ignores the effects of the Fear (X) Special Rule.

rules.name: Strand of Warding
rules.summary: Silver wire and prayer-tags turn aside the witch's reach.
rules.text: Psychic Checks made by enemy Models to target a Model with this Special Rule, or its Unit, suffer a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Marked Quarry
rules.summary: The lens finds the one face it was told to find.
rules.text: Once in each of the Controlling Player's Shooting Phases, the first Shooting Attack made by a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule against an enemy Unit adds 1 to its Hit Tests.

rules.name: Plated in Spite
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty by a Melee Attack, the enemy Unit that removed it suffers one automatic Hit with a Strength of 4 and an AP of –.

rules.name: Chaff Veil
rules.summary: A cloud of foil and filament blinds the pursuing guns.
rules.text: The first Shooting Attack made against a Unit with this Special Rule in each battle subtracts 1 from its Hit Tests.

armyRules.name: Hounded by Fate
armyRules.flavor: The two Knights-Errant march with the weight of what they have seen.
benefits: Nathaniel Garro and Tylos Rubio cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.
drawbacks: Nathaniel Garro and Tylos Rubio may only be joined to Units of Automata from this army, and are never counted as part of a Legion for any other friendly Special Rule.

armyRules.name: Cold Hunters
armyRules.flavor: The Mechanicum automata of the cell are built for a single purpose, and have no patience for anything else.
benefits: Automata add 1 to their Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
drawbacks: An Automata Unit cannot hold or contest an Objective unless Nathaniel Garro or Tylos Rubio is within 12".

rites.name: Garro's Company
rites.flavor: A handful of oath-breakers and loyalists, bound by the one thing neither side believed in.
benefits: Castellax Battle, Castellax Destructor and Domitar Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Maniples gain Oath-Bonded: while within 12" of Garro or Rubio they add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics when taking a Morale Check or Cool Check.
Garro and Rubio add 1 to their Initiative Characteristic.
limitations: Garro or Rubio must be in the army.
No Vorax Attack Maniples or Vultarax Stratos Squadrons.

rites.name: The Hunter-Killer Cell
rites.flavor: Four fast engines, one sealed order, and nobody to ask what it said.
benefits: Vorax Attack Maniples and Vultarax Stratos Squadrons may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Sealed Orders: Outflank, and in a Battle Turn in which a Unit arrives from Reserves it may Rush and still make a Shooting Attack with one Weapon.
limitations: At least one Vorax Attack Maniple is required.
Every Vorax and Vultarax must start the battle in Reserve.
No Thanatar Siege, Domitar Battle or Castellax Destructor Maniples.

modifiers.text: The Hunter-Killer Cell: Line (1), Sealed Orders.

rites.name: The Unwitnessed Writ
rites.flavor: Some orders are carried out in silence, by engines that cannot be questioned and cannot talk.
benefits: Thanatar Siege Maniples may fill Elites slots.
Thanatar and Domitar Maniples gain Infiltrate (9) and Unwitnessed: in the first Battle Turn the enemy cannot target them with Shooting Attacks unless within 12".
limitations: At least one Thanatar Siege Maniple is required.
No Vorax Attack Maniples or Vultarax Stratos Squadrons.

require.note: The writ needs a Thanatar to carry it out.
